finding: Official spec facts retrieved on 2026-10-05. (1) Transaction header v1 carries: req_compute_units, req_state_units, req_memory_units, a uint64 fee declared by the fee payer, uint64 nonce, start_slot, expiry_after (slots until expiry), chain_id, one fee_payer_pubkey and ONE program_pubkey with a single instruction-data blob — so one transaction invokes one program; atomic multi-call needs a multicall program or CPI (execution results reference cross-program invocation account attribution). (2) Validation: nonce must exactly match the fee payer's current nonce and advances immediately; slots must satisfy start_slot <= current < expiry; fee is collected at pre-execution and failed executions still keep nonce advancement and fee collection. (3) Resources: 1 CU per byte of instruction/data, syscall base 512 CU, memory units are 4KB pages, state units derive from net account bytes added per page. (4) Transport: gRPC documented for apps and gRPC-Web documented 'for browser-based applications'; streaming services (e.g. StreamSlotMetrics) exist. (5) Execution results expose compute_units_consumed, state_units_consumed and program user_error_code. This is documentary evidence; behavior that can move funds still requires live-chain confirmation before a write path is enabled.
